outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Minutes - Board of Education - Regular Meeting – September 9, 2026

enrichment.headline: Ratifies Alison Mata's appointment to the school facilities bond oversight committee
enrichment.summary: The board ratifies the board president's appointment of Alison Mata as a member of the Measures B, J, Y Independent Citizens' School Facilities Bond Oversight Committee. The appointment starts September 24, 2026 and covers the unexpired term ending June 30, 2028. There is no fiscal impact.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Adopts a resolution naming the board president's appointees to the 7-11 Committee
enrichment.summary: The board adopts Resolution No. 2627-0154 naming the members the board president appointed to the 7-11 Committee. The text does not list the members. There is no fiscal impact.

outcome.action: Adopted

enrichment.headline: Adopts a resolution naming members and terms of the Career Technical Education Advisory Committee
enrichment.summary: The board adopts Resolution No. 2627-0154 naming the members, and their terms, of the Career Technical Education Advisory Committee. The text does not list the members. There is no fiscal impact.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Appointments - Career Technical Education Advisory Committee - Superintendent of Schools - President, Board of Education

enrichment.headline: Pays Soccer Without Borders up to $30,000 for academic case management at Oakland International High
enrichment.summary: Soccer Without Borders will provide intensive academic case management for students in its existing athletic programs, with individual and group sessions, social-emotional learning workshops and other support to prevent dropouts. The agreement runs August 10 to September 30, 2026. The board is ratifying (approving after the fact) this agreement.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - Soccer Without Borders - Oakland International High School

enrichment.headline: Pays Soccer Without Borders up to $14,400 for lunchtime social-emotional sessions at Oakland High
enrichment.summary: Soccer Without Borders will hold twice-weekly lunch sessions for over 30 Oakland High School students to build social-emotional learning skills, using two curricula: one on attendance, behavior and personal values, and one on healthy relationship skills. The agreement runs September 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
